rationale: The supplied source does not establish a locally repairable D2 missing rule for clause 20. CBTRN02C processes incoming daily transactions, validates account references, credit limits and expiration, and posts balances. The clause requires identifying unused cards, sending intimation, tracking replies, closing accounts subject to dues, and updating the CIC. Neither the proposed locus nor concrete execution evidence establishes that lifecycle. All behavioral fixture checks are empty, so intended behavior and preservation claims remain unavailable.
scope_judgment: The allowlisted CBTRN02C.cbl lines 370–378 contain the transaction-validation dispatcher and an additional-validation comment. They expose no last-use history, notice date, reply state, closure workflow or CIC interface. The account copybook includes balances and an active-status field but no demonstrated inactivity or notification lifecycle. Processing only incoming transactions also does not demonstrate discovery of cards with no activity. This scope is insufficiently grounded for the proposed regulatory behavior.
intended_fixture_judgment: The intended-regulatory-behavior check is empty and provides no inputs, expected outputs or external-state observations. Coverage is absent for the more-than-one-year threshold, calendar boundaries, intimation before closure, replies within the 30-day window, no reply at the window boundary, dues handling, and CIC updates within 30 days. Empty checks cannot count as passes.
regression_fixture_judgment: Both unaffected-outside-locus and class-specific-regression checks are empty. There are no concrete fixtures preserving valid posting, invalid-card and missing-account rejection, credit-limit boundaries, expiration boundaries, category-balance creation or updates, account balances, transaction records, reject records or return codes. Preserving the PROCEDURE DIVISION literal establishes no behavioral regression result.
capability_judgment: The packet reports GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 and batch_executable/copybook_fanout support, but case_checks_executed is false. Compiler availability does not establish functioning indexed-file fixtures or the notice, reply, closure and CIC state required by this case. The backend supports finite fixture evidence and explicitly lacks complete semantic equivalence and several static value-flow proofs; it cannot substitute for missing behavioral checks.
duplicate_source_judgment: Preselection before detector results and explicit grouping of repeated source bundles provide a defensible procedural reason to retain dependent candidates for review. Any later reporting must retain bundle dependence, report case and distinct-bundle counts, and avoid independent-case interval claims. This justification does not supply missing regulatory evidence, and the condition requiring all reviewers to approve is not satisfied by this exclusion.
unresolved_issues: No source-grounded connection between clause 20 and the allowlisted transaction-validation locus.
No demonstrated state or interfaces for inactivity, intimation, replies, account closure or CIC reporting.
No concrete intended-behavior fixtures or regulatory boundary coverage.
No concrete unaffected or class-specific regression fixtures.
